name: Detective pony
tips: Before you report a bug, search the project's issues, the closed ones too: someone may have met the same problem, and the answer is often already there.
On GitHub, the search box of the Issues tab starts with `is:issue is:open`. Remove `is:open` to search the closed issues too.
A closed issue isn't always fixed: read the last comments to see if it was solved, refused, or a duplicate of another one.
personal: Elementary! The answer was in a closed issue all along.
Every clue counts. Even the old, closed ones.
I never open a case before I read the old ones.
